'''Keene''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] member of the [[Vrath Xizor]]'s team in [[3653 BBY]] for the purpose to track the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]]. Keene was Vrath's speeder driver in his team and he picked up the survivors of the team after a [[Skirmish in the Yinta Lake spaceport|skirmish]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. He, like the rest of the surviving team members were told to rendezvous on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in three days, although Xizor was killed before then.
